# Pourtype

> Pourtype is a macOS menu-bar app that types your clipboard into fields that block paste, and copies text out of anything visible on screen. It runs locally, makes no network requests and collects no data.

Pourtype is made by Leonard Chow, an individual Apple developer. It requires macOS 14 or later. It is planned for the Mac App Store at US$2.99 (one-time purchase) and is not on the App Store yet. The source code is available on GitHub under the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license: source-available, free for personal and noncommercial use. It is not open source.

## Who it is for
Mac users who meet fields or dialogs that refuse paste, people who need text out of images, PDFs or video, and people who prefer tools that do not send data anywhere.

## Features
- Type the clipboard (Command-Shift-V): types the clipboard into the focused field as real keystrokes, for fields that block paste. While it types, the screen is frosted except the window being typed into, and the keyboard and mouse are held so focus cannot move. Esc stops it at once. Hold Up/Down to change speed (3-150 characters per second); hold Left/Right to change rhythm from steady to random. A card shows the target app and window, the text streaming, progress and seconds left. With several displays, the other displays show a small card pointing to the target display. If another app comes to the front it stops, and keystrokes are delivered only to the target app. Newlines are typed as Shift+Return so chat boxes do not send early; tabs become spaces. Chinese, Japanese and Korean text and emoji are supported.
- Grab text (Command-Shift-C): drag a box anywhere on screen; the text inside is recognised on-device with Apple Vision (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese) and copied to the clipboard.
- History: grabbed and typed texts are kept locally and are searchable; copy or type them again; they can be cleared; retention can be 7, 30, 90 or 365 days.

## Limits
- In password fields macOS turns on Secure Input. The keyboard cannot be held there, so Pourtype falls back to plain typing. Control-Option-Command-Period stops it.
- Not yet available on the Mac App Store.

## Privacy
Runs locally. Makes no network requests. Collects no data. Text recognition happens on the Mac. History is stored only on the Mac and can be cleared. Permissions used: Accessibility (to type and to hold the keyboard and mouse while typing) and Screen Recording (to read the box the user draws).

## Frequently asked
- How do I type into a field that blocks paste on Mac? Copy the text, click into the field, press Command-Shift-V.
- How do I copy text from an image on Mac? Press Command-Shift-C and drag a box over the text.
- How do I stop it? Press Esc. In a password field, press Control-Option-Command-Period.
- Can I change the shortcuts? Yes, in Settings: click a shortcut and press the new combination (it needs Command, Control or Option).
- Which languages is the app in? English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese; it follows the Mac's language.

## Guides
- [Copy text from an image, video or screen on a Mac](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/guides/copy-text-from-screen-mac/) (English): In Photos, Preview and Safari, hold the pointer over text in a picture, drag to select it, then Control-click and choose Copy. This is Live Text and it is free. For anywhere Live Text does not reach, take a screenshot and run the Shortcuts "Extract Text from Image" action, or drag a box with a screen-grab app such as Pourtype.
- [Macで画像・動画・画面の文字をコピーする方法](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/ja/guides/copy-text-from-screen-mac/) (日本語): 写真やプレビューの画像内の文字は、macOSの「テキスト認識表示」で選択してコピーできます。それ以外の場所や画面全体の文字は、スクリーンショットとショートカットアプリで認識するか、画面を囲んでコピーするPourtype（⌘⇧C）が使えます。まず無料の標準機能を試すのがおすすめです。
- [Mac 截图识别文字：图片、视频、PDF 文字提取](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/zh-hans/guides/copy-text-from-screen-mac/) (简体中文): 照片、预览和 Safari 里的图片，用 Mac 自带的实况文本：拖选文字，按住 Control 点按，选「拷贝」。暂停的视频画面在部分 App 里也能用，这是第三方文章的说法，Apple 中文页没有写，详见下文。其他地方的文字，可以先截图再用快捷指令识别，或者用 Pourtype 的 ⌘⇧C 在屏幕任意位置框选，在本机识别并复制。
- [Mac 圖片轉文字：截圖、影片、PDF 的文字擷取](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/zh-hant/guides/copy-text-from-screen-mac/) (繁體中文): 照片和圖片裡的文字，用 Mac 內建的「原況文字」就能選取、拷貝，免費。原況文字集中在 Apple 自己的 App（照片、預覽程式、Safari 等）；其他 App、或螢幕上任何不是圖片的位置，可以先截圖，再用原況文字取字，或用 Pourtype 的 ⌘⇧C 框選螢幕範圍辨識。
- [Website won't let you paste? How to fill it in on a Mac](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/guides/paste-blocked-mac/) (English): Start free: let your password manager fill the field, or switch off JavaScript for that one site in Chrome. If the field still refuses paste, something has to type the text for you as real keystrokes: an AppleScript, Keyboard Maestro, Hammerspoon, or a menu-bar app such as Pourtype. For a few characters, typing by hand is the simplest option.
- [貼り付け禁止の入力欄にMacで入力する方法](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/ja/guides/paste-blocked-mac/) (日本語): 貼り付けを止めているのは多くの場合、Macではなくそのページのスクリプトです。まずパスワード管理アプリの自動入力を試し、だめなら、短い文字列は手で打つのが確実です。長い文字列は、クリップボードの中身をキー入力として打ち込むツール（Pourtypeの⌘⇧Vなど）が使えます。
- [网页禁止粘贴怎么办？Mac 上的几种输入方法](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/zh-hans/guides/paste-blocked-mac/) (简体中文): 先试免费办法：确认不是剪贴板的问题，再让密码管理器自动填充；少量文字直接手打最省事。如果一个禁止粘贴的输入框要填很长的内容，可以用 Pourtype：复制好文字，点进输入框，按 ⌘⇧V，它把剪贴板里的内容当作键盘按键逐字输入。
- [網頁禁止貼上怎麼辦？Mac 輸入方法整理](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/zh-hant/guides/paste-blocked-mac/) (繁體中文): 先分清楚是「欄位不讓貼上」還是「來源不讓複製」：前者可以讓密碼管理工具自動填入，或改用按鍵把文字一個字一個字打進欄位；後者要先把畫面上的文字擷取出來。短文字最簡單的辦法是自己打；文字很長、或含中文與表情符號時，再考慮用腳本或 Pourtype 的 ⌘⇧V 逐字輸入。
- [Type the clipboard as keystrokes on a Mac: 4 ways](https://shuaige121.github.io/pourtype/guides/type-clipboard-as-keystrokes-mac/) (English): The free routes are an AppleScript that sends keystroke through System Events, or a short Hammerspoon script using hs.eventtap.keyStrokes. Keyboard Maestro does it with a paid macro, and menu-bar apps such as Pourtype do it with a shortcut. All of them need Accessibility access, and they differ mainly in non-English text, emoji and speed.
